title.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì
title.english: He is three years older than me

instruction.hanzi: 给下面的词语选择对应的图片
instruction.english: Match the pictures with the words/phrases.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 王方,昨天和你一起唱歌的人是谁?
dialogue.pinyin: Wáng Fāng, zuótiān hé nǐ yìqǐ chàng gē de rén shì shéi?
dialogue.english: Wang Fang, who was the guy with you in the karaoke yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 什么朋友?是不是男朋友?
dialogue.pinyin: Shénme péngyou? Shì bu shì nán péngyou?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 不是不是,我同学介绍的,昨天第一次见。
dialogue.pinyin: Bú shì bú shì, wǒ tóngxué jièshào de, zuótiān dì yī cì jiàn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 左边这个看报纸的女孩子是你姐姐吗?
dialogue.pinyin: Zuǒbian zhège kàn bàozhǐ de nǚ háizi shì nǐ jiějie ma?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Èrshíwǔ suì, tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.
dialogue.english: 25. He's three years older than me.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.english: What's the price of watermelons today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 是,苹果也比昨天便宜一些。您来点儿吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì, píngguǒ yě bǐ zuótiān piányi yìxiē. Nín lái diǎnr ba.
dialogue.english: Yes. Apples are also cheaper. Why not take some?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 前边说话的那个人就是我的汉语老师。你可能不认识她。
dialogue.pinyin: Qiánbian shuō huà de nàge rén jiù shì wǒ de Hànyǔ lǎoshī. Nǐ kěnéng bú rènshi tā.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Shì xīn lái de Hànyǔ lǎoshī ma?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Shì qùnián lái de, tā xìng Wáng, èrshíbā suì.
dialogue.english: She came last year. Her family name is Wang, she's 28.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒmen lǎoshī xiǎo liǎng suì.
dialogue.english: She's two years younger than my teacher.

title.english: A Verb (Phrase) Used as an Attributive Modifier

explanation.hanzi: 动词或动词短语做定语时,定语和中心语之间要加"的"。
explanation.english: When a verb or verb phrase modifies a noun, "的" goes between the modifier and the noun.

explanation.hanzi: 用"比"表示比较的句子叫"比"字句。"比"字句的谓语可以是形容词。否定形式用"A没有B……"。要表达差别时,用具体数量表示具体差别,"一点儿"或"一些"表示差别不大,"多"或"得多"表示差别大。
explanation.english: A "比" sentence uses "比" to compare. The predicate can be an adjective. The negative form is "A 没有 B…". A specific quantity gives the exact difference; "一点儿/一些" means "a little"; "多/得多" means "much more".

examples.english: Older brother isn't as tall as older sister.
Today isn't as hot as yesterday.
Watermelon isn't as cheap as apples.

explanation.hanzi: "可能"表示估计、也许、或许。常用在动词前,也可用在主语前。
explanation.english: "可能" expresses estimation — "maybe, perhaps, probably". Usually before the verb, but can precede the subject.

examples.hanzi: 他可能早就知道这件事情了。
examples.pinyin: Tā kěnéng zǎo jiù zhīdào zhè jiàn shìqing le.
examples.english: He probably knew about this long ago.

examples.hanzi: 可能我明天不来上课了。
examples.pinyin: Kěnéng wǒ míngtiān bù lái shàng kè le.
examples.english: I might not come to class tomorrow.
